propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed under its matching --class without --force, because close_plan_review_gate_check does not receive the close_class parameter and cannot exempt administrative dispositions

The close_plan_review_gate_check function signature lacks close_class and disposition parameters, making it structurally unable to see or honour link-backed administrative evidence that the completion verification gate already checks

Attempting rebar review-plan on a superseded ticket with legitimate reason to block creates an unsatisfiable attestation requirement: the gate demands certification for a plan that cannot pass review by construction
An unavoidable force-close of a superseded descendant ticket causes the entire ancestor chain to lose its completion signature, even when the force-close itself is evidence-backed and administrative
The fix requires threading close_class and tracker into close_plan_review_gate_check and exempting only link-backed dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when _has_live_replacement_link returns True
